events.event: PVMBG raised Gunung Bromo to Level II (Waspada) after an eruption sent an ash column about 500 m above the peak, drifting west.
events.key_numbers: Eruption 5 Nov 2026 17:11 WIB · ash column ~500 m (about 2,829 m asl) · Level II Waspada · 1 km exclusion radius around crater · max amplitude 23 mm, tremor ~46 s
events.why_it_matters: Bromo is a major tourist site, and visitors and tour operators are now barred from the crater area, with sudden phreatic eruptions possible.
events.spreading_evidence: On CNN Indonesia nasional latest list; reported by several outlets (TIMES, Kumparan, Viva, Harian Jogja, detik video)

events.event: Of eight crew on the TNI AD Mi-17V5 that crashed while water-bombing karhutla in Tanjung Puting National Park, five survived and were evacuated to Banjarmasin; two bodies were recovered and one was still being searched for.
events.key_numbers: Crash ~11:00 WIB 5 Nov 2026 (took off Kuala Pembuang 09:55) · 8 crew · 5 survivors · 3 dead/missing (Lettu Col Dudi Firmansyah, Capt Nurhafiz Akbar recovered; SSgt Heri Prasetyo still searched)
events.why_it_matters: It shows how dangerous the firefighting effort is and how severe the fires in Central Kalimantan have become.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets (CNN Indonesia, Antara, Liputan6, Bisnis, iNews, IDN Times)

events.event: ANTARA rated as false a viral post claiming interbank transfers and e-wallet transactions will be taxed from 9 November 2026; the Finance Ministry and DJP say only the SPP-TDLN VAT collection on foreign digital goods and services applies.
events.key_numbers: Claimed start date 9 Nov 2026 · Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara denial 3 Nov 2026 · SPP-TDLN under PMK No. 49/2026 · no change to VAT rate · fintech VAT only on service fees (PMK 69/2022)
events.why_it_matters: The rumour touches every bank and e-wallet user, and the date is three days away so the confusion will spread.
events.spreading_evidence: Spread on Threads; ANTARA debunk on its cek-fakta list 6 Nov; origin tied to Hashim Djojohadikusumo's digital tax remarks. No outlet most-read ranking seen.

events.event: ANTARA rated as hoax a post saying WHO will directly monitor all MBG free-meal kitchens after poisoning cases; oversight stays with the Health Ministry, BGN and BPOM.
events.key_numbers: WHO is 1 of 13 members of the Donor & UN Country Network for Nutrition · BGN release 28 Oct 2026 · 14 feasibility indicators for SPPG kitchen inspections
events.why_it_matters: People are hearing MBG food safety is now under an international body when it is not.

events.event: ANTARA rated as hoax a post claiming Malaysia and Brunei fined Indonesia Rp17 trillion over karhutla haze; Foreign Ministry says no protest notes were received.
events.key_numbers: Claimed fine Rp17 trillion · Malaysian Deputy PM rejected compensation 16 Sep 2026 · Malaysian FM said diplomatic route 15 Oct 2026 · 2002 ASEAN haze agreement has no automatic fine
events.why_it_matters: Rumours of huge haze fines on Indonesia are circulating while haze diplomacy is actually calm.

events.event: ANTARA rated as hoax a poster saying KLHK declared Kalimantan orangutans totally extinct due to karhutla, citing ministry data on animals under treatment.
events.key_numbers: 290 wildlife individuals from fires under treatment as of 8 Oct 2026 (272 by BKSDA in 4 Kalimantan provinces) · 96 Kalimantan orangutans (25 in Central Kalimantan) · 9 orangutans released 29 Oct 2026 in Ketapang · ~3.2 km firebreak in Paring Lahung
events.why_it_matters: A false extinction claim is emotional and shareable, while the real numbers show rescues are ongoing.
events.spreading_evidence: Social media poster; ANTARA cek-fakta 6 Nov

events.event: Former President Jokowi responded to talk in the DPR of impeaching Vice President Gibran, saying he respects legal processes and constitutional rights.
events.key_numbers: MA ruled Gibran's SMA-equivalence suket invalid 30 Oct 2026 · MK ruling 6 Oct 2026 left diploma issue to parliament · Jokowi remarks 5 Nov 2026 after East Jakarta court hearing
events.why_it_matters: It is the first public reaction from Jokowi to the impeachment talk after the MA ruling.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia nasional #1 latest; detik terpopuler has related Jokowi/Gibran items (#1, #3)

events.event: Jokowi's adjutant and Dumatno are scheduled to testify as witnesses at the East Jakarta District Court in the Roy Suryo and dr Tifa case next week.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 12 Nov 2026 · witnesses: Jokowi's adjutant and Dumatno
events.why_it_matters: The next hearing continues a case that tops the most-read lists.
events.spreading_evidence: detik terpopuler #4 and #9; CNN Indonesia nasional several items
